cases.name: Nicole Marie Crawford
cases.about:
She was a teacher for 16 years and worked with special needs students. 

Her obituary said, "She was a teacher at Charles W. Bush Early Education Center Wilmington, DE. She was passionate about helping special needs children and was beloved by her students and faculty.

Nicole was a positive, beautiful soul, with a loving caring heart, full of life, with a smile that could light up the room. She loved the outdoors, the beach, and the adventures of travel. Her greatest passion was spending time with her children teaching them about culture, education, family values and the blessing of a large, close family; celebrating the importance of holidays and milestone moments."

https://www.dohertyfh.com/obituary/Nicole-Crawford
cases.narrative: On 2/26/2021, police found her body in her bedroom after her mother Araina Crawford told police she'd gone to her daughter's home after her employer said she didn't show up for work.
